# Conductor Shortcuts

Provides quick VS Code commands to copy `/conductor.*` slash commands to the clipboard and optionally open Copilot Chat.

Usage

- Open Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P) and run one of:
  - `Conductor: Copy /conductor.status`
  - `Conductor: Copy /conductor.setup`
  - `Conductor: Copy /conductor.newTrack <title>`
  - `Conductor: Copy /conductor.implement <track_id>`
  - `Conductor: Copy /conductor.revert <track_id> <phase|task>`

After running, the slash command is copied to your clipboard. Click "Open Copilot Chat" in the prompt to attempt to open the Copilot Chat panel, then paste the command into the chat input.
